item.tib: 'chi med yab sras rnam gsum thugs kyi bsgrubs pa las las byang thog rgod 'bar ba'i 'phreng ba
item.coloph: ces pa bla chen yab sras rnam gsum thugs sgrub las byang thog rgod 'phro ba'i 'phreng ba zhes bya ba 'di gnas chen shel brag su (tu) kho bo rang lo bdun thob sa phag zla 1tshes 1nyi shar skabs rig 'dzin gyis (gyi) tshogs gral du phyin nas bla chen dran pa rig 'dzin tshogs kyis rgyud lung dbang dang gsang mtshan nod cing mkha' 'gro'i gnyer gtad lo bdun gyis (gyi) gsang rgya thub par byas nas phyis su bka' rgya yol mtshams dben gnas mad+hal ri khrod du ge khod bsnyen bsgrubs skabs shing sbrul zla 10tshes 9kyi nub mor tshe dbang rig 'dzin chen po'i (pos) lo tsa'i brda' yig 'dug pa kho bo dbra rigs g.yung drung bstan 'dzin dbang rgyal bdag la gnang ba'o tshes 10kyi nyi shar bod yig tu phab pa'o//
